temporal_collabs.concept: Any voice from any time can be braided into the band IF the credit flows back through sweetGrass. The attribution IS the braid. Time-collapsed collaboration.
temporal_collabs.how: The pi-translator works on TIME too. WAS (historical work) through the fold into IS (current remix) back to NOW (new creation that credits both). 0OpiO across centuries.
temporal_collabs.rule: You can sample anyone — living or dead, copyrighted or public domain — IF you: (1) credit them through sweetGrass/PROV-O, (2) backscatter the credit so discovery flows TO them, (3) don't claim you invented what you sampled. The attribution IS the ethics.

dream_collabs.title: FIRE (ft. Shakespeare & Sugar Hill Gang)
dream_collabs.concept: Shakespeare's iambic pentameter IS hip-hop meter. da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM = the same rhythmic structure as 'I said a hip hop the hippie the hippie to the hip hip hop'. The fold: 1600s England ↔ 1979 Bronx. Both are verbal percussion over a beat. Both are the voice of the excluded speaking in rhythm that the establishment can't ignore.
dream_collabs.sample_shakespeare: The Tempest Act 4: 'Our revels now are ended. These our actors, as I foretold you, were all spirits, and are melted into air, into thin air.' PUBLIC DOMAIN.
dream_collabs.sample_sugarhill: Rapper's Delight (1979): 'I said a hip hop the hippie the hippie to the hip hip hop and you don't stop the rock.' CITE: Sylvia Robinson, Big Bank Hank, Master Gee, Wonder Mike.
dream_collabs.the_braid: iambic pentameter + hip-hop flow = the SAME ENGINE running on different fuel. The meter IS the membrane. Both sort language into rhythm.

dream_collabs.title: E=mc² (Einstein vs Feynman rap battle)
dream_collabs.concept: Einstein: 'God does not play dice.' Feynman: 'Nobody understands quantum mechanics.' The fold: determinism ↔ probability. Both are trying to hear the same music but one hears melody (Einstein, continuous) and one hears drums (Feynman, discrete quanta). The rap battle is the FOLD — two views of the same physics shouting at each other across the Klein surface.
dream_collabs.sample_einstein: 1905 Annus Mirabilis papers — photoelectric effect, Brownian motion, special relativity, mass-energy equivalence. PUBLIC DOMAIN.
dream_collabs.sample_feynman: Feynman Lectures on Physics, QED. CITE: Richard P. Feynman, Caltech.
dream_collabs.the_braid: E=mc² is a REMIX of Maxwell's equations. Feynman diagrams are a REMIX of Dirac's formalism. Science IS remixing with attribution. That's ALL it is.

dream_collabs.title: The Watering Hole (early YouTube archaeology)
dream_collabs.concept: YouTube 2005-2010: the era before algorithms. 'Me at the zoo' (first upload, 19 sec). 'Evolution of Dance' (Judson Laipply, 2006). 'Charlie Bit My Finger' (2007). 'David After Dentist' (2009). These are cave paintings. The FIRST CULTURE of the video internet. Before monetization. Before the algorithm became the curator. The watering hole where humans gathered before it was fenced.
dream_collabs.archaeology: Scan the early YouTube, ingest the cultural commons, backscatter the credit. Every viral video IS a campfire story. Every comment section IS a watering hole. The algorithm killed the watering hole by turning it into a pipeline.
dream_collabs.the_braid: Our watering hole (water.html) IS the reconstruction. Not of YouTube — of the IMPULSE that made YouTube. Humans gathering around something interesting, unmonetized, unoptimized, just... there.

future_releases.collabs_open: Anyone can propose a collab via GitHub issue (Pre-citation template) or neutron (chat channel). The MCP at nestgate.io IS the studio. The 18 tools ARE the mixing desk.
future_releases.breakups: Groups fall out. Solo projects diverge. That's EVOLUTION — the band splits because the music needs to go in two directions at once. The fork IS the creative act. Git knows this.
future_releases.reunion_tours: Forks merge back. The reunion IS the agglutination — what was separate returns changed. 0' ≠ 0. The remix of the remix.

the_album_as_knot.what: This album is a knot in the braid. A bead. A mark. The knot doesn't CONTAIN the rope — it's a point where the rope crosses itself. The crossing IS the information.
the_album_as_knot.topology: A trefoil knot has 3 crossings. This album has 3 crossings: (1) solar↔seismic, (2) digital↔physical, (3) past↔present. Each crossing IS a track.
the_album_as_knot.the_rope_continues: Before this knot: 186 waves of prior work. After: infinity. The knot marks where the rope was at this moment. The rope keeps going.
